name: Heightmaps
note: The heightmaps clients get are computed from the blocks: WORLD_SURFACE, MOTION_BLOCKING (states that are solid or hold a fluid, minecraft.wiki "Heightmap") and, for 1.21.8, MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES; which states count matches both official servers for every state
deviations: server-side heightmaps (OCEAN_FLOOR and the world-generation ones) are not kept; generation and mob spawning need them (C7, C8)
